title: 第二十章 方家第二十一章 又被抓走了
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
随着晨光洒落大地，沉寂了一夜的广宁城，自安静之中苏醒。
街道上香气飘洒，沿街两侧，各种各样的摊贩比比皆是。
马车行于路中，行人分别左右。
四方城门各自开启，迎来送往，好不热闹。
一对农夫打扮的年轻夫妇，也随着人流进了城。
只是那女子神色略显冷冽，目光比寻常的农妇要凌厉很多。
男子倒是看不出有什么特别之处，眼神随着人群奔走，目光带着些小心，时不时的扯那女子一把，似乎在嫌她冒失。
就这样一路磕磕绊绊的来到了一家客栈，那男子和掌柜的抠抠搜搜的商量半天，这才用了一半的银子，开了一个房间。
进了房间关上门，那女子这才松了口气。
来到桌前倒了一杯茶
“方兄，天上那几只鹰隼，果然就是他们的耳目。
“打死之后，这一路都没有再发现黑煞教的人。”
一路走来看谁都显得卑微的农夫，则挺直了腰杆，轻轻活动了一下脖子说道
“其实也可以不打死，让黑煞教的人借此一次次的找上门来，自寻死路。
“不过如此一来，会显得有些被动。
“而且我们到了广宁城的事情，会被他们提前察觉。还不如由明转暗，让这攻守易势。”
这两个人自然就是方书文和周青梅。
自孙家借宿至此，已经又过了七天。
他们两个借农户的服饰，伪装成夫妻俩，一路上平平安安的抵达了广宁城。
方书文此时也坐了下来，端起茶杯喝了一口

“大小姐，你这凌厉的眼神，有些时候还是得收一收。
“谁家农妇像你一样，眼睛亮的好似刀子一样……被有心人看在眼里，很容易看出破绽的。”
周青梅眨了眨眼睛
“有吗？”
方书文认真的点了点头，然后摆了摆手说道
“不过这也不重要。
“如今广宁城已经到了，线索有两条。
“除了那个大玄钱庄之外，便是你当时发现淫贼的那一家了。
“可还记得那一家在何处？”
“自然记得。”
周青梅说道
content_en:
As the morning light fell on the earth, Guangning City, which had been silent all night, woke up from its silence.
The streets are filled with fragrance, and various vendors can be found along both sides of the street.
The horse-drawn carriage was driving on the road, and pedestrians were walking around.
The city gates in all four directions were opened respectively, welcoming people and sending them off, it was so lively.
A young couple dressed as farmers also followed the crowd into the city.
It's just that the woman's expression is slightly cold, and her eyes are much sharper than those of ordinary peasant women.
The man didn't see anything special. He followed the crowd with his eyes, a little cautious, and pulled the woman from time to time, as if he thought she was rash.
In this way, he stumbled all the way to an inn. The man and the innkeeper discussed it for a long time, and then spent half of the money to open a room.
After entering the room and closing the door, the woman breathed a sigh of relief.
Came to the table and poured a cup of tea
"Brother Fang, those falcons in the sky are indeed their eyes and ears.
“After being beaten to death, no one from the Black Evil Cult was found along the way. "
The farmer, who looked humble to everyone along the way, straightened his back, moved his neck slightly and said
"Actually, we don't have to kill him, and let the people from the Black Evil Cult come to us again and again to seek death.
“But in this way, it will appear a bit passive.
“And when we arrive in Guangning City, they will notice it in advance. It's better to switch from light to dark and change the offensive and defensive situation. "
These two people are naturally Fang Shuwen and Zhou Qingmei.
Seven more days have passed since I stayed at Sun's house.
The two of them borrowed the farmer's clothes, disguised themselves as a couple, and arrived in Guangning City safely along the way.
Fang Shuwen also sat down at this time, picked up the teacup and took a sip.
"Miss, your sharp eyes need to be tempered sometimes.
"Whose peasant woman is like you, her eyes are as bright as knives...if someone looks into her eyes, it's easy to see the flaws."
Zhou Qingmei blinked her eyes
"Is there any?"
Fang Shuwen nodded seriously, then waved his hand and said
“But that’s not important.
"Now that Guangning City has arrived, there are two clues.
"Aside from the Daxuan Bank, this is the one where you discovered the adulterer.
"But still remember where that family is? "
"Of course I remember. "
Zhou Qingmei said
